stories.title: Shanghai Shock — Hurkacz Beats Djokovic for First Time, Ends Four-Time Champion's Run

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
HUGE UPSET IN SHANGHAI: Hubert Hurkacz def. Novak Djokovic 6-4, 6-3 — the first time Hurkacz has beaten Djokovic. Was 0-8 all-time.

Djokovic, fresh off his 102nd career title in Beijing, falls in his earliest-ever Shanghai exit. #ATP #Shanghai
x_posts.tweet_type: FOLLOW-UP (Oct 8 S3: Shanghai Day 2, Hurkacz vs. Djokovic R2 set up → R2 RESULT)

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Hurkacz on his first career win over Djokovic: "It's a special night."

13 aces, saved both break points. Djokovic looked drained after winning the Beijing title days earlier. 6-4, 6-3. #Shanghai #ATP #Hurkacz
x_posts.tweet_type: FOLLOW-UP (Oct 8 S3: Shanghai Day 2, Hurkacz vs. Djokovic R2 set up → R2 RESULT)

research.facts:
Hurkacz Beats Djokovic at Shanghai
**Source 1:** tennisnow.com — "Hurkacz Tops Djokovic for First Time, Stretches Shanghai Streak to 8 Wins"
- Score confirmed: 6-4, 6-3
- "First time Hurkacz has topped Djokovic" (was 0-8 before this match)
- Hurkacz: 13 aces, 2 double faults, 70% first serve
- Broke at 5-4 to take first set (53 minutes)
- Broke in fourth game of second set, served out at 5-3
- "Drained by his rousing Beijing run" — Djokovic fatigue factor
- Hurkacz had retired in Beijing SF with adductor problem
**Source 2:** thebiglead.com — "Hubert Hurkacz ousts Novak Djokovic at Shanghai Masters"
- Confirms R2 result, describes as "Djokovic's earliest Shanghai Masters defeat"
- Multiple reports describe it as R2 (second round)
**Source 3:** tennistonic.com — "LIVE UPDATES. Hubert Hurkacz defeats Djokovic in the 2nd round at the Shanghai Rolex Masters"
- Live coverage, confirms 6-4, 6-3
**Source 4:** tennisworldusa.org — "Hubert Hurkacz provides Novak Djokovic's earliest Shanghai Masters defeat"
- Confirms earliest Shanghai exit
**Source 5:** yahoo sports — Hurkacz reaction quote: "It's a special night"
**Confidence:** HIGH — Score 6-4, 6-3 confirmed by multiple sources; first career win confirmed; serve stats from tennisnow.com (single source — MEDIUM)
